fields.description: Armani Beach Residences brings Tadao Ando’s architecture and Armani/Casa interiors to Palm Jumeirah’s outer crescent. The collection pairs large private homes with beach access, pools and residents-only spaces for exercise, relaxation and entertaining.
amenities: Gym, spa, sauna and ice bath

overview: Arada’s March 2026 update describes 57 individually designed homes. Apartments, penthouses and two presidential suites share a development with approximately 90,000 ft² of amenities.
The developer’s property collection marks its displayed homes sold out. This does not establish whether a particular resale or subsequent release is available.
research.locationNote: The project stands on Palm Jumeirah’s outer crescent in Dubai. Nearby landmarks include Atlantis and the Arabian Gulf; views depend on the selected residence.
research.priceNote: No current unit-specific primary quotation was verified. Property Finder displays an AED 26 million rounded launch guide and AED 26.46 million in its FAQ. Arada’s AED 92.5 million sale announcement is a historical transaction, not an available offer.
research.paymentNote: No dated primary payment sheet was retrieved. The table is Property Finder’s reference 25/35/40 split. A broker instead gives 10/35/55 with a different instalment calendar; neither is treated as a confirmed current contract.
research.handoverNote: The July 2025 construction award targeted end-2027, reaffirmed by Arada in March 2026. Property Finder lists December 2027. This is a forecast, not a verified completion or handover certificate.

facts.label: Main construction contract
facts.value: Arada awarded AED 678 million to China Tiesju Civil Engineering in July 2025; enabling, piling and shoring were complete at that announcement.

facts.label: Historical transaction
facts.value: Arada reported a five-bedroom, 11,521 ft² residence sold for AED 92.5 million on 16 March 2026.
